body:
There was this DMT trip back near the beginning of my own personal journey with DMT that I thought was one to remember.  I apologize if my paragraph structure is not perfect as I did not finish high school yet I can still type well so no worries, just read without paragraphs.  Make sure to remember that I ate Mcdonald's before taking this DMT.  Now when I was doing all of the toking during my experience I used a bong with no water.  There were screens packed on top of each other to hold the DMT, at least 3.  I packed in a 30 mg hit of the nn-dimethyltryptamine which had a yellow tinge.  When I took my first toke I held in the DMT vapor, or what I attempted to vaporize correctly.  As I hit everything in my one hit I sat there on the couch where I sat posted up toking and waited holding in the toke for as long as 30 seconds or so.  That's when while I was holding in the toke I burst out puking in front of me on the carpet, this was a basement in a house.  As I puked I saw the trip escalate in intensity.  All of the light emitted into the room had turned neon blue.  I was also covered in neon blue light completely, head to toe.  After getting up to look around my surroundings for a little bit just looking at everything and walking around, the experience ended after 10 minutes or so.
